card.name: Spatial and size words in geography text
card.fires_on: Words about physical space and scale in general web prose, such as galaxy, distances and area units, or small words like of and the that introduce a place or extent.

modes.label: Galaxy and astronomy nouns
modes.description: The word galaxy, galaxies or outflow in astronomy news about black holes.
modes.example: the gas in the<< galaxy>>’s center until it reaches a temperature where

modes.label: Distances and area measures
modes.description: A number or unit of length or area, such as one, km or miles, in descriptions of size or distance.
modes.example: The bailey could cover anywhere from<< one>> to three acres.

modes.label: Linking words before places
modes.description: Small words like of or the right before a place or landscape noun.
modes.example: The coordinates of<< the>> ruins are The highway distance to is Sil

card.plain: It lights up on words describing places, distances and sizes, especially galaxies, in ordinary non-medical text.
